mainEntity.name: Should I use an aerosol spray can or hire a professional with a hopper gun?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary tradeoff lies between control and convenience. Aerosol texture cans work adequately for tiny touch-ups under a few square inches, but they often produce erratic pressure, splatter large droplets, and dry unpredictably. A professional hopper gun connected to a compressor allows the technician to adjust fluid viscosity and air volume precisely. This control is critical for matching existing wall profiles on repairs larger than a fist, preventing visible lap marks or uneven buildup.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spray cans suit tiny spots but lack pressure control. Professional hopper guns allow precise adjustment of droplet size and air pressure, ensuring seamless blends on larger patches.
